verses.original: וְהַנָּחָשׁ֙ הָיָ֣ה עָר֔וּם מִכֹּל֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה אַ֚ף כִּֽי־ אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל עֵ֥ץ הַגָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nā·ḥāš hā·yāh ‘ā·rūm mik·kōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer ’el- hā·’iš·šāh ’ap̄ kî- ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō ṯō·ḵə·lū mik·kōl ‘êṣ hag·gān
verses.literal: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that the LORD God had made And he said to the woman Did God really . . . say You must not eat from any tree in the garden
verses.literalPt: ORA, a serpente era mais astuta que todas as alimárias do campo que o SENHOR Deus tinha feito. E esta disse à mulher: É assim que Deus disse: Não comereis de toda a árvore do jardim?

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ הַנָּחָ֑שׁ מִפְּרִ֥י עֵֽץ־ הַגָּ֖ן נֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’el- han·nā·ḥāš mip·pə·rî ‘êṣ- hag·gān nō·ḵêl
verses.literal: The woman answered . . . the serpent We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden
verses.literalPt: E disse a mulher à serpente: Do fruto das árvores do jardim comeremos,

verses.original: וּמִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַגָּן֒ אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְלֹ֥א תִגְּע֖וּ בּ֑וֹ פֶּן־ תְּמֻתֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mip·pə·rî hā·‘êṣ ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- hag·gān ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō ṯō·ḵə·lū mim·men·nū wə·lō ṯig·gə·‘ū bōw pen- tə·mu·ṯūn
verses.literal: but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden God has said You must not eat of it or touch it or you will die
verses.literalPt: Mas do fruto da árvore que está no meio do jardim, disse Deus: Não comereis dele, nem nele tocareis para que não morrais.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַנָּחָ֖שׁ אֶל־ הָֽאִשָּׁ֑ה לֹֽא־ מ֖וֹת תְּמֻתֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer han·nā·ḥāš ’el- hā·’iš·šāh lō- mō·wṯ tə·mu·ṯūn
verses.literal: You will not surely die . . . the serpent told . . . the woman
verses.literalPt: Então a serpente disse à mulher: Certamente não morrereis.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יֹדֵ֣עַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֗י בְּיוֹם֙ אֲכָלְכֶ֣ם מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנִפְקְח֖וּ עֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִיתֶם֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים יֹדְעֵ֖י ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·ḏê·a‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî bə·yō·wm ’ă·ḵā·lə·ḵem mim·men·nū wə·nip̄·qə·ḥū ‘ê·nê·ḵem wih·yî·ṯem kê·lō·hîm yō·ḏə·‘ê ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘
verses.literal: For God knows that in the day you eat of it your eyes will be opened and you will be like God knowing good and evil
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus sabe que no dia em que dele comerdes se abrirão os vossos olhos, e sereis como Deus, sabendo o bem e o mal.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣רֶא הָֽאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּ֣י טוֹב֩ הָעֵ֨ץ לְמַאֲכָ֜ל וְכִ֧י תַֽאֲוָה־ ה֣וּא לָעֵינַ֗יִם וְנֶחְמָ֤ד הָעֵץ֙ לְהַשְׂכִּ֔יל וַתִּקַּ֥ח מִפִּרְי֖וֹ וַתֹּאכַ֑ל וַתִּתֵּ֧ן גַּם־ לְאִישָׁ֛הּ עִמָּ֖הּ וַיֹּאכַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re hā·’iš·šāh kî ṭō·wḇ hā·‘êṣ lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl wə·ḵî ṯa·’ă·wāh- hū lā·‘ê·na·yim wə·neḥ·māḏ hā·‘êṣ lə·haś·kîl wat·tiq·qaḥ mip·pir·yōw wat·tō·ḵal wat·tit·tên gam- lə·’î·šāh ‘im·māh way·yō·ḵal
verses.literal: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom she took the fruit and ate it She also gave some . . . to her husband who was with her and he ate it
verses.literalPt: E viu a mulher que aquela árvore era boa para se comer, e agradável aos olhos, e árvore desejável para dar entendimento; tomou do seu fruto, e comeu, e deu também a seu marido, e ele comeu com ela.

verses.original: וַתִּפָּקַ֙חְנָה֙ עֵינֵ֣י שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י עֵֽירֻמִּ֖ם הֵ֑ם וַֽיִּתְפְּרוּ֙ עֲלֵ֣ה תְאֵנָ֔ה וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם חֲגֹרֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tip·pā·qaḥ·nāh ‘ê·nê šə·nê·hem way·yê·ḏə·‘ū kî ‘ê·rum·mim hêm way·yiṯ·pə·rū ‘ă·lêh ṯə·’ê·nāh way·ya·‘ă·śū lā·hem ḥă·ḡō·rōṯ
verses.literal: And the eyes of both of them were opened and they knew that they were naked so they sewed together fig leaves and made coverings for themselves
verses.literalPt: Então foram abertos os olhos de ambos, e conheceram que estavam nus; e coseram folhas de figueira, e fizeram para si aventais.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־ ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּגָּ֖ן לְר֣וּחַ הַיּ֑וֹם וַיִּתְחַבֵּ֨א הָֽאָדָ֜ם וְאִשְׁתּ֗וֹ מִפְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּת֖וֹךְ עֵ֥ץ הַגָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm miṯ·hal·lêḵ bag·gān lə·rū·aḥ hay·yō·wm way·yiṯ·ḥab·bê hā·’ā·ḏām wə·’iš·tōw mip·pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘êṣ hag·gān
verses.literal: Then the man and his wife heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day and they hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden
verses.literalPt: E ouviram a voz do SENHOR Deus, que passeava no jardim pela viração do dia; e esconderam-se Adão e sua mulher da presença do SENHOR Deus, entre as árvores do jardim.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ אַיֶּֽכָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- hā·’ā·ḏām way·yō·mer lōw ’ay·yek·kāh
verses.literal: But the LORD God called out to the man - Where are you
verses.literalPt: E chamou o SENHOR Deus a Adão, e disse-lhe: Onde estás?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת־ קֹלְךָ֥ שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בַּגָּ֑ן וָאִירָ֛א כִּֽי־ עֵירֹ֥ם אָנֹ֖כִי וָאֵחָבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’eṯ- qō·lə·ḵā šā·ma‘·tî bag·gān wā·’î·rā kî- ‘ê·rōm ’ā·nō·ḵî wā·’ê·ḥā·ḇê
verses.literal: I heard Your voice in the garden he replied and I was afraid because I was naked so I hid myself
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Ouvi a tua voz soar no jardim, e temi, porque estava nu, e escondi-me.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֚י הִגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עֵירֹ֖ם אָ֑תָּה הֲמִן־ הָעֵ֗ץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר צִוִּיתִ֛יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֥י אֲכָל־ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אָכָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mî hig·gîḏ lə·ḵā kî ‘ê·rōm ’āt·tāh hă·min- hā·‘êṣ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā lə·ḇil·tî ’ă·ḵāl- mim·men·nū ’ā·ḵā·lə·tā
verses.literal: Who told you that you were naked asked the LORD God Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat
verses.literalPt: E Deus disse: Quem te mostrou que estavas nu? Comeste tu da árvore de que te ordenei que não comesses?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הָֽאָדָ֑ם הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה עִמָּדִ֔י הִ֛וא נָֽתְנָה־ לִּ֥י מִן־ הָעֵ֖ץ וָאֹכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·’ā·ḏām hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tāh ‘im·mā·ḏî hî nā·ṯə·nāh- lî min- hā·‘êṣ wā·’ō·ḵêl
verses.literal: And the man answered The woman whom You gave me she gave me fruit from the tree and I ate it
verses.literalPt: Então disse Adão: A mulher que me deste por companheira, ela me deu da árvore, e comi.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־ זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑ית וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה הַנָּחָ֥שׁ הִשִּׁיאַ֖נִי וָאֹכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·’iš·šāh mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śîṯ wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh han·nā·ḥāš hiš·šî·’a·nî wā·’ō·ḵêl
verses.literal: Then the LORD God said to the woman What is this you have done The serpent deceived me she replied and I ate
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR Deus à mulher: Por que fizeste isto? E disse a mulher: A serpente me enganou, e eu comi.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ אֶֽל־ הַנָּחָשׁ֮ כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּאת֒ אָר֤וּר אַתָּה֙ מִכָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וּמִכֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה עַל־ גְּחֹנְךָ֣ תֵלֵ֔ךְ וְעָפָ֥ר תֹּאכַ֖ל כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- han·nā·ḥāš kî ‘ā·śî·ṯā zōṯ ’ā·rūr ’at·tāh mik·kāl hab·bə·hê·māh ū·mik·kōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ‘al- gə·ḥō·nə·ḵā ṯê·lêḵ wə·‘ā·p̄ār tō·ḵal kāl- yə·mê ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: So the LORD God said to the serpent Because you have done this cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field On your belly will you go and dust you will eat all the days of your life
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR Deus disse à serpente: Porquanto fizeste isto, maldita serás mais que toda a fera, e mais que todos os animais do campo; sobre o teu ventre andarás, e pó comerás todos os dias da tua vida.

verses.original: וְאֵיבָ֣ה׀ אָשִׁ֗ית בֵּֽינְךָ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ וּבֵ֣ין זַרְעָ֑הּ ה֚וּא יְשׁוּפְךָ֣ רֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תְּשׁוּפֶ֥נּוּ עָקֵֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·ḇāh ’ā·šîṯ bê·nə·ḵā ū·ḇên hā·’iš·šāh ū·ḇên zar·‘ă·ḵā ū·ḇên zar·‘āh hū yə·šū·p̄ə·ḵā rōš wə·’at·tāh tə·šū·p̄en·nū ‘ā·qêḇ
verses.literal: And I will put enmity between you and the woman and between your seed . . . and her seed He will crush your head and you will strike his heel
verses.literalPt: E porei inimizade entre ti e a mulher, e entre a tua semente e a sua semente; esta te ferirá a cabeça, e tu lhe ferirás o calcanhar.

verses.original: אֶֽל־ הָאִשָּׁ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הַרְבָּ֤ה אַרְבֶּה֙ עִצְּבוֹנֵ֣ךְ וְהֵֽרֹנֵ֔ךְ בְּעֶ֖צֶב תֵּֽלְדִ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְאֶל־ אִישֵׁךְ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָתֵ֔ךְ וְה֖וּא יִמְשָׁל־ בָּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’el- hā·’iš·šāh ’ā·mar har·bāh ’ar·beh ‘iṣ·ṣə·ḇō·w·nêḵ wə·hê·rō·nêḵ bə·‘e·ṣeḇ tê·lə·ḏî ḇā·nîm wə·’el- ’î·šêḵ tə·šū·qā·ṯêḵ wə·hū yim·šāl- bāḵ
verses.literal: To the woman He said I will sharply increase . . . your pain in childbirth in pain you will bring forth children Your desire will be for your husband and he will rule over you
verses.literalPt: E à mulher disse: Multiplicarei grandemente a tua dor, e a tua conceição; com dor darás à luz filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará.

verses.original: וּלְאָדָ֣ם אָמַ֗ר כִּֽי־ שָׁמַעְתָּ֮ לְק֣וֹל אִשְׁתֶּךָ֒ וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ מִן־ הָעֵ֔ץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּיתִ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֲרוּרָ֤ה הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּֽעֲבוּרֶ֔ךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’ā·ḏām ’ā·mar kî- šā·ma‘·tā lə·qō·wl ’iš·te·ḵā wat·tō·ḵal min- hā·‘êṣ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā lê·mōr lō ṯō·ḵal mim·men·nū ’ă·rū·rāh hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ba·‘ă·ḇū·re·ḵā bə·‘iṣ·ṣā·ḇō·wn tō·ḵă·len·nāh kōl yə·mê ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: And to Adam He said Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded . . . you not to eat cursed is the ground because of you through toil you will eat of it all the days of your life
verses.literalPt: E a Adão disse: Porquanto deste ouvidos à voz de tua mulher, e comeste da árvore de que te ordenei, dizendo: Não comerás dela, maldita é a terra por causa de ti; com dor comerás dela todos os dias da tua vida.

verses.original: וְק֥וֹץ וְדַרְדַּ֖ר תַּצְמִ֣יחַֽ לָ֑ךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ אֶת־ עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qō·wṣ wə·ḏar·dar taṣ·mî·aḥ lāḵ wə·’ā·ḵal·tā ’eṯ- ‘ê·śeḇ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Both thorns and thistles it will yield for you and you will eat the plants of the field
verses.literalPt: Espinhos, e cardos também, te produzirá; e comerás a erva do campo.

verses.original: בְּזֵעַ֤ת אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ תֹּ֣אכַל לֶ֔חֶם עַ֤ד שֽׁוּבְךָ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה לֻקָּ֑חְתָּ כִּֽי־ עָפָ֣ר אַ֔תָּה וְאֶל־ עָפָ֖ר תָּשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·zê·‘aṯ ’ap·pe·ḵā tō·ḵal le·ḥem ‘aḏ šū·ḇə·ḵā ’el- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh kî mim·men·nāh luq·qā·ḥə·tā kî- ‘ā·p̄ār ’at·tāh wə·’el- ‘ā·p̄ār tā·šūḇ
verses.literal: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread until you return to the ground because out of it were you taken For dust you are and to dust you shall return
verses.literalPt: No suor do teu rosto comerás o teu pão, até que te tornes à terra; porque dela foste tomado; porquanto és pó e em pó te tornarás.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א הָֽאָדָ֛ם שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ חַוָּ֑ה כִּ֛י הִ֥וא הָֽיְתָ֖ה אֵ֥ם כָּל־ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā hā·’ā·ḏām šêm ’iš·tōw ḥaw·wāh kî hî hā·yə·ṯāh ’êm kāl- ḥāy
verses.literal: And Adam named his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living
verses.literalPt: E chamou Adão o nome de sua mulher Eva; porquanto era a mãe de todos os viventes.

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְאָדָ֧ם וּלְאִשְׁתּ֛וֹ כָּתְנ֥וֹת ע֖וֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·’ā·ḏām ū·lə·’iš·tōw kā·ṯə·nō·wṯ ‘ō·wr way·yal·bi·šêm
verses.literal: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and He clothed them
verses.literalPt: E fez o SENHOR Deus a Adão e à sua mulher túnicas de peles, e os vestiu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים הֵ֤ן הָֽאָדָם֙ הָיָה֙ כְּאַחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לָדַ֖עַת ט֣וֹב וָרָ֑ע וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ פֶּן־ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יָד֗וֹ וְלָקַח֙ גַּ֚ם מֵעֵ֣ץ הַֽחַיִּ֔ים וְאָכַ֖ל וָחַ֥י לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm hên hā·’ā·ḏām hā·yāh kə·’a·ḥaḏ mim·men·nū lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘ wə·‘at·tāh pen- yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw wə·lā·qaḥ gam mê·‘êṣ ha·ḥay·yîm wə·’ā·ḵal wā·ḥay lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: Then the LORD God said Behold the man has become like one of Us knowing good and evil And now lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat and live forever
verses.literalPt: Então disse o SENHOR Deus: Eis que o homem é como um de nós, sabendo o bem e o mal; ora, para que não estenda a sua mão, e tome também da árvore da vida, e coma e viva eternamente,

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֛הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִגַּן־ עֵ֑דֶן לַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֻקַּ֖ח מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·lə·ḥê·hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm mig·gan- ‘ê·ḏen la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer luq·qaḥ miš·šām
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR Deus, pois, o lançou fora do jardim do Éden, para lavrar a terra de que fora tomado.

verses.original: וַיְגָ֖רֶשׁ אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּשְׁכֵּן֩ מִקֶּ֨דֶם לְגַן־ עֵ֜דֶן אֶת־ הַכְּרֻבִ֗ים וְאֵ֨ת לַ֤הַט הַחֶ֙רֶב֙ הַמִּתְהַפֶּ֔כֶת לִשְׁמֹ֕ר אֶת־ דֶּ֖רֶךְ עֵ֥ץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḡā·reš ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām way·yaš·kên miq·qe·ḏem lə·ḡan- ‘ê·ḏen ’eṯ- hak·kə·ru·ḇîm wə·’êṯ la·haṭ ha·ḥe·reḇ ham·miṯ·hap·pe·ḵeṯ liš·mōr ’eṯ- de·reḵ ‘êṣ ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: So He drove out the man and stationed cherubim on the east side of the Garden of Eden along with a whirling sword of flame to guard the way to the tree of life
verses.literalPt: E havendo lançado fora o homem, pôs querubins ao oriente do jardim do Éden, e uma espada inflamada que andava ao redor, para guardar o caminho da árvore da vida.
